name: com.pncsolution.metacore
description: Metacore SDK is a Unity package for developing content for Metalense 2. It includes MRTK3 by default and is compatible with Snapdragon Spaces and QCHT Interactions. The package provides a template environment with sample scenes for rapid mixed reality content development. To fully enable Snapdragon Spaces and hand tracking functionality, you must manually add the following packages to your project: com.qualcomm.qcht.unity.interactions (v4.1.13) and com.qualcomm.snapdragon.spaces (v1.0.2). Please visit https://spaces.qualcomm.com/developer/ar-sdk/ to download the required SDKs and import them into your Unity project.

samples.description: Sample scenes for Metalense 2 development, featuring a base scene utilizing Snapdragon Spaces and MRTK3 integration.
